bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2020. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2021 (9-month YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Jul-Sep 2021) figures, not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3) quality is good. Extensively cross-validated: 31-Dec-2020 comparative matches 2020_Q4.json exactly; the 9M-2020 and Q3-2020-discrete comparative columns (profit paid on deposits, net investment income, income from shares, commission, other operating income, total operating income, operating expenses, provision, tax) all match 2020_Q3.json's own figures exactly. Two digit-insertion OCR errors were caught and corrected via this cross-check: the source's own 'Profit / (loss) before provision (C=A-B)' cell for 9M-2020 misprinted as '(426,241,081)' (an extra '4' -- correct value, confirmed by A-B and by 2020_Q3.json, is -126,241,081) and its 'Total provision (D)' cell for 9M-2021 misprinted as '(36,000,000)' (should be -30,000,000, confirmed by the chain C-D=PBT and by the adjacent 'Specific provision' line which correctly read -30,000,000). Income-statement chain closes exactly once these two corrections are applied (A-B=C, C-D=PBT, PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.47, all matching the filing's own clean 'Selective Notes' section).
